records.label: spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores#1
records.source: Reads the measurement store selected by ``measurement_backend`` from :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, merges the object feature tables selected by ``tables`` using their existing parent-object joins, uses the wells marked as ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (or an annotation column) as training labels, delegates fitting to :func:`ml_analysis`, and writes per-object predictions, permutation and feature-importance tables plus a plate heatmap into ``results/`` under the first source folder.
records.context: Reads the measurement store selected by ``measurement_backend`` from :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, merges the object feature tables selected by ``tables`` using their existing parent-object joins, uses the microplate sample positions marked as ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (or an annotation column) as training labels, delegates fitting to :func:`ml_analysis`, and writes per-object predictions, permutation and feature-importance tables plus a laboratory microplate heatmap into ``results/`` under the first source folder.
records.translation: Les mæligagnageymsluna sem ``measurement_backend`` velur úr :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, sameinar eiginleikatöflur hluta sem ``tables`` velur með fyrirliggjandi tengingum þeirra við yfirskipaða hluti, notar brunna merkta ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (eða merkingardálk) sem þjálfunarmerkingar, felur :func:`ml_analysis` líkanaðlögunina og skrifar spár fyrir hvern hlut, umraðana- og eiginleikamikilvægistöflur ásamt hitakorti plötunnar í ``results/`` undir fyrstu upprunamöppunni.
records.review_basis: Exact-source technical translation review: selected measurement backend and object tables, retained parent-object joins and limits, unique registered tables with an object anchor, exact four-table default order, channel selection for recruitment ratio only and documented error conditions. records.source: ``tables`` (list or tuple) — unique registered object-table names, optionally including ``png_list``; at least one object table is required. When absent, reads ``cell``, ``nucleus``, ``pathogen`` and ``cytoplasm`` in that order. Selected tables retain the shared reader's existing joins and nucleus/pathogen limits.
